placements.title: Graceful Degradation When Identifiers Are Absent
placements.frame: What must the system do when it encounters input that lacks an expected identifier field — crash or produce a valid fallback?
placements.why: src-1 identifies the production failure pattern (a ## heading with no id field) and src-2 sets the deontic constraints (must not crash, must produce a valid slug). Together they name a recurring subject — how the system degrades when expected identifiers are missing — that future envelopes will keep feeding. No existing leaf covers this theme.
